descriptionChirho: Physically lacking contents or possessions; sent away with nothing, empty-handed (Mark 12:3; Luke 1:53; 20:10-11).

Without purpose, effect, or substance; used figuratively of efforts that accomplish nothing, words that lack truth, or deception that is hollow (1 Cor 15:10,14,58; 2 Cor 6:1; Gal 2:2; Eph 5:6; Phil 2:16; Col 2:8; 1 Thess 2:1; 3:5; Acts 4:25).
Empty-headed, lacking understanding; used as a vocative epithet to address a person who is devoid of spiritual sense (James 2:20).
